text_block_list.text:
Passing near a classroom, I spotted Ikuno 
Dictus and Admire Vega talking to each 
other.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
According to the student council, it will 
take a week for the new equipment to 
arrive.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Until then, let us maintain everything 
thoroughly and hold out with what we 
currently have.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For today, I shall inspect the existing 
equipment inventory.
choice_data_list:
(If I recall... both of them are on the 
General Affairs Committee.)

text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus began glancing back and forth 
between her tablet and the equipment, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...The numbers do not match.

Before long, she sank into deep thought 
with a troubled look. Did something 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It appears that one set of checked-out 
horseshoe maintenance tools is missing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I checked the logs. It seems one person 
is overdue on their return.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I see... Then that must be the cause.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
With our reserves running low, other 
students may find themselves unable to 
borrow what they need.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I shall go speak with that student 
directly. —Please excuse me.

With that, Ikuno Dictus headed off to 
search for the student.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—So, you are saying she has already headed 
out for training?

text_block_list.name: Bright Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looked like she went straight to the 
course right after class ended!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Pardon...? Has she already finished her 
training session?

text_block_list.name: Kind Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Looks like it. She wrapped up early today 
and said she'd go rest in her room~.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Meaning she has already returned to the 
dorms...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(With our spare stock so limited, if the 
items have been misplaced...)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —I must track her down.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —! Found you...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, may I speak with you for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Forgetful Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Forgetful Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Wwah, I-I'm so sorry...!! It completely 
slipped my mind...!!

text_block_list.name: Forgetful Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Here is what I borrowed...!! I am truly, 
terribly sorry for the trouble...!!

Walking near the gymnasium that night, I 
came across Ikuno Dictus once again. It 
seemed she was conducting an equipment 
check.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Three, four, five... Good, everything is 
accounted for.
choice_data_list:
Have you been searching for it this entire 
time?
Were you searching all this time?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It was necessary to fulfill my duties 
as a member of the General Affairs 
Committee.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And above all— to properly manage these 
vital tools.

It must have been exhausting, yet perhaps 
from a sense of accomplishment— her 
expression showed clear satisfaction.
